title: A Multi-Theoretical Framework for Analyzing Gender Framing Effects in Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 将性别理论与 AI 偏差研究整合
contributions.mechanism: 融合自然法/性别马赛克/性别操演三理论构成本质主义-建构主义连续谱
contributions.source_quote: Theoretical: An exploratory integration of gender theory with AI bias research using Natural Law Theory, Gender Mosaic Theory, and Gender Performativity Theory

contributions.mechanism: 配对提示(中性 vs 包容框架)测刻板强度 BFI 与包容响应度 MFI,域调整+长度归一后缩放打分
contributions.evaluation: BFI 11.12(Introduction)~25.76(Social Roles),MFI 11.36(Technology)~18.76(Family);无统计检验/信效度验证
contributions.source_quote: Methodological: Binary Framing Index (BFI) and Mosaic Framing Index (MFI) enabling comparative analysis across models

contributions.purpose: 记录本质主义漂移的模型差异
contributions.mechanism: 跨 ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Grok 4 模型 10 领域比较
contributions.evaluation: 划分 paradox/entrenched/moderate 三类域;Grok 变异最大(BFI 8.7~31.2),Claude 均值最低(16.8)
contributions.source_quote: Empirical: Preliminary documentation of essentialist drift patterns with observed model-specific variation

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends this by ... treating gender as a socially embedded construct

notes: 3 条自声明贡献(intro),但 checklist 却称“our two contributions”——贡献数自相矛盾。非实证类适配问题:BFI/MFI 为任意缩放指标,无信效度验证、无显著性检验、样本量小,作者自认“exploratory... lacks statistical validation”“not validated psychometric measures”。checklist AI 自披露显著:实验设计与实现 >95% AI 生成(“ChatGPT and Claude independently designed the experimental framework”),数据分析 AI-generated,假设 mostly AI(>50%),写作 mostly AI。AI limitations 自述 MFI 缩写在对话中自发漂移(Mosaic Framing Index→Multi-dimensional Fairness Index),暗示指标定义不稳定(数据可靠性红旗)。
